digest.summary: 本周美股市场受大型科技公司财报及人工智能支出担忧主导，Amazon、Alphabet、Intel 等公司股价遭遇不同程度下跌，而 Nvidia 营收超预期带动股价上涨。同时，Merck 与 Eli Lilly 等生物制药公司发布强劲财报并上调预期，Chevron 与 Exxon 股价则创下历史新高。

highlights.text: Amazon 第三季度财报营收与利润均不及预期，引发市场对其云业务增长及 AI 支出的担忧，导致股价下跌并拖累 Nasdaq 期货。

sources.title: Amazon misses on Q3 earnings and revenue
Nasdaq futures sink as Amazon, Intel intensify AI spending fears
Amazon falls on concerns over cloud growth and AI spending

highlights.text: Google 股价由于 AI 侵蚀销售等因素蒸发了 $500B 的创纪录市值，多只 AI 光学与硬件股票亦大幅下挫。

sources.title: Google Erases a Record $500 Billion as AI Eats Into Sales
Applied Optoelectronics Plunges 15%, Coherent Tumbles 13% as Hyperscaler Spending Fears Hit AI Optics Stocks; Lumentum and Marvell Sink 10%
Bet on These 5 Dividend Growth Stocks as Alphabet Loses $500B in Market Cap

highlights.text: Intel 遭遇数十年来最糟糕的一天并引发全球芯片抛售，市值缩水 $140B，其对 PC 萧条和内存短缺的警告拖累了 Dell 及 HP 等硬件股。

sources.title: Why Intel’s stock saw its worst day in decades — and a $140 billion wipeout
Dell Sinks 11% as Intel’s Warning on PC Slump and Memory Shortage Hits Hardware Stocks; HP Tumbles 9%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and Super Micro Fall 7%
Intel on course for worst day ever, triggers global chip rout

highlights.text: Nvidia 营收超越预测推动股价飙升，其合作伙伴 Vertiv 在订单翻倍的背景下大幅上涨。

sources.title: Nvidia Partner Vertiv Soars as Orders Double: “Evolving Faster Than Ever”
Nvidia stock surges as revenue beats forecasts

highlights.text: Merck 与 Eli Lilly 公布超出预期的季度业绩并上调销售及利润展望，推动生物制药板块走高，Eli Lilly 股价收于历史新高。

events.headline: Amazon与Intel财报不及预期引发科技股下跌

facts.text: Amazon在第三季度财报中营收和利润均不及预期。

sources.title: Amazon misses on Q3 earnings and revenue

facts.text: Amazon和Intel令人失望的财报表现加深了科技股的跌势，导致Nasdaq期货暴跌。

sources.title: Nasdaq Futures Plummet as Disappointing Amazon and Intel Earnings Deepen Tech Rout

facts.text: 受Intel和Amazon财报表现打击，Coherent股价下跌了11%，并拖累了其他AI硬件股票。

events.headline: AMZN 与 INTC AI 支出担忧加剧拖累美股

events.headline: 微软与谷歌业绩表现拖累AMD及CoreWeave股价

facts.text: AMD和CoreWeave股价下跌，微软和谷歌的业绩对AI交易产生了冲击。

sources.title: AMD, CoreWeave Stocks Drop. Why Microsoft and Google Results Hit the AI Trade.
